text:
The drop of dew that sleeps within
the chalice of the whitest lily
is the crystal palace where
the happy spirit of purity lives.

He gives it mystery and poetry;
he lends it its soothing fragrance.
Alas for the flower if, kissed by light,
that pearl evaporates!

translation.title: Rhyme XCV: The Drop of Dew That Sleeps in the Lily
